$schema: Session state manifest v3 - vertical phase slices, programmatic updates only
description: Transition the current pi-extension asset loop into a standalone TUI application that uses the Pi SDK to deterministically orchestrate the render-critique-fix loop

open_questions: Exact Usage aggregation shape from pi-ai complete()
pi-tui Image fallback behavior in non-supporting terminals
Whether bun run asset-loop needs a top-level workspace alias
key_decisions: Use Pi SDK rather than Pi extension
Each fix-step receives full context (4 images + files + 1 issue)
Batch fix, single verify per critique cycle
TUI shows inline images via pi-tui Image component
Orchestrator writes accepted.json directly (no LLM accept tool)
Critic parse failure aborts the loop
Initial gen is single SDK call with write tools
TUI surfaces iter/phase/current issue, pending issues queue, token+cost meter
Print summary and exit on termination

plan_state.summary: CP5 complete: orchestrator.ts gains buildTerminationSummary(input) — a module-level helper between writeAcceptedJson and runAssetLoop that returns string[] composed of asset id, iter N/MAX, termination kind, residual count + per-issue '[severity] region: description' lines, optional accepted.json path, and the formatted usage line. The three termination sites (hit_empty, cap_reached, parse_failure) all build the summary via this helper, call tui.showSummary(summary) (skipped on parse_failure), then tui.stop(), then console.log(summary.join('\n')) so the canonical block survives in scrollback after pi-tui restores the terminal. parse_failure additionally mirrors the block to console.error to keep error context next to the existing 'aborted: critic parse failure …' line. Legacy pi-extension surface retired: apps/pi-asset-loop/extensions/asset-loop.ts deleted, the now-empty extensions/ directory removed, and the 'pi' script stripped from apps/pi-asset-loop/package.json — scripts is now exactly { postinstall, asset-loop, typecheck }. README Run section updated to invoke 'bun run asset-loop' so 'rg extensions/asset-loop apps/pi-asset-loop' returns zero matches. Static verification gates pass: typecheck exit 0, ripgrep cleanliness check zero matches, extensions/ directory gone, package.json scripts shape correct. Runtime end-to-end (interactive terminal + live API credentials) deferred to operator. UsageSnapshot type imported into orchestrator. One deviation from plan action 9: formatUsageSnapshot already prefixes its return with 'usage: ', so the helper appends formatUsageSnapshot(usage) directly instead of the doubled `usage: ${formatUsageSnapshot(usage)}` from the plan.
